hero.headline: I turn ideas into web applications.
hero.description: As a third-year Software Engineering student, I build modern web applications, REST APIs and solutions designed to address real-world needs.

about.title: A developer passionate about building useful solutions.
about.paragraph1: I am a third-year Computer Science student specializing in Software Engineering at ESMIA Innovation. I develop web applications and REST APIs using modern technologies.
about.paragraph2: Through my projects, I have gained experience with React, Spring Boot, FastAPI, Django and PostgreSQL. I am particularly interested in software architecture, API design and code quality.
about.paragraph3: I am seeking a six-month internship to contribute to real-world projects, strengthen my skills and grow within a development team.

skills.title: The technologies I use to build my projects.
skills.description: A collection of languages, frameworks and tools I use to develop web applications and REST APIs.

projects.title: A selection of projects I have developed.
projects.description: Applications designed to solve real-world problems, from data modeling to user interface and REST API development.

electricity.title: Electricity Outage Management and Prediction
electricity.description: A web platform for managing, reporting and predicting electricity outages in Madagascar. Development of a REST API with 72 endpoints, including analytics, notifications and prediction modules.

textile.title: Textile Order Management
textile.description: An application for managing textile orders and production workflows, tracking cutting, sewing and finishing stages, managing statuses and providing REST APIs.

parking.title: Parking Management System
parking.description: An application for managing parking spaces, vehicles, reservations and payments, including availability tracking and a dashboard.

students.title: Student and Course Management
students.description: A Django web application for managing students and courses, featuring CRUD operations, forms and a responsive interface.

textile.description: A web application for managing orders and the production workflow of a textile company. It centralizes orders and tracks their progress through to delivery.
textile.objectives: Centralize order management, organize production stages and improve delivery deadline tracking.

features.orders: Management of customer orders and their items.
features.production: Organization of production stages: cutting, sewing and finishing.
features.tracking: Tracking of order statuses and production progress.
features.users: User management and assignment of responsibilities.

screenshots.dashboardDescription: Overview of business activities and key indicators.
screenshots.ordersDescription: View registered orders and monitor their status.
screenshots.productionDescription: Track the progress of the different production stages.
screenshots.loginDescription: Interface allowing users to log in to the platform according to their roles.
screenshots.administrationDescription: Administration area for managing users and platform access.
screenshots.clientDescription: Customer area for viewing orders and tracking their progress.
screenshots.notificationDescription: Notifications informing users about events related to their orders.
screenshots.orderManagerDescription: Interface for the manager to view and manage customer orders.
screenshots.productionTrackingDescription: Monitor the progress of production stages as a manager.
screenshots.operatorTaskDescription: Operator area for viewing and processing assigned production tasks.

electricity.description: A web platform for reporting, managing and analyzing electricity outages in Madagascar, with data visualization and prediction features.
electricity.objectives: Improve electricity outage monitoring, centralize incident reports and use available data to generate analytics and predictions.

features.management: Management and monitoring of reported incidents.
features.prediction: Prediction of electricity outages based on available data.
features.statistics: Visualization of statistics and outage data through an interactive map.

screenshots.dashboardDescription: Overview of outage reports, power cuts, and key electricity network statistics.
screenshots.mapDescription: Geographical location of power outages to visualize the affected areas.
screenshots.managementDescription: Interface allowing the network manager to review, approve, or reject outage reports.
screenshots.predictionsDescription: Presentation of prediction results to anticipate potential power outages.
screenshots.administrationDescription: Administration area for managing users and platform access.
screenshots.loginDescription: Authentication interface allowing users to access their workspace according to their role.

parking.description: A web application for managing a parking facility, including parking spaces, reservations, customers and financial operations.
parking.objectives: Centralize parking management, monitor space availability and simplify reservation and financial operations.

features.places: Management of parking spaces and their availability.

screenshots.placesDescription: View parking spaces with their numbers, zones, and availability status.
screenshots.reservationsDescription: View and manage customers' parking reservations.
screenshots.financeDescription: Monitor payments and view financial information related to parking sessions.
screenshots.clientsDescription: View and manage customer information and their vehicles.

students.description: A Django web application for managing students, their information and common student administration operations.
students.objectives: Simplify student record management and facilitate the viewing, creation and modification of student information.

features.list: Viewing the list of registered students.

screenshots.listDescription: Display of registered students and their main information.
screenshots.creationDescription: Form for registering a new student and uploading a profile picture.
screenshots.detailsDescription: View detailed student information, including associated courses.
screenshots.editingDescription: Form for updating a student's personal and academic information.

upcomingProjects.description: New ideas and challenges to explore to strengthen my skills and build practical solutions.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy Management System
pharmacy.description: A web application designed to centralize pharmacy operations, including medicines, procurement, sales, and inventory tracking.

features.medicines: Management of the medicine catalog and its categories.
features.inventory: Inventory tracking by batch with expiration date monitoring.
features.fefo: Implementation of the FEFO method to prioritize medicines with the nearest expiration dates.
features.sales: Management of sales, payments, and product returns.
features.suppliers: Management of suppliers, purchases, and procurement.
features.alerts: Alerts for low stock levels and approaching expiration dates.
features.dashboard: Dashboard displaying statistics, revenue, and transaction history.

angular.title: Angular Interfaces for Textile and Parking Systems
angular.description: Modernization of the Textile and Parking application interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, leveraging existing Spring Boot REST APIs.

features.textile: New interface for managing textile orders and production tracking.
features.parking: New interface for managing parking spaces, reservations, and parking sessions.
features.api: Integration and consumption of existing Spring Boot REST APIs.

fishFarming.title: Fish Farming Management SaaS
fishFarming.description: A SaaS platform designed to manage multiple fish farming operations, monitor production cycles, and centralize technical and financial management.

features.ponds: Management of fish farms, ponds, and fish batches.
features.feeding: Tracking of fish feeding, inventory, and technical activities.
features.growth: Monitoring of fish growth, mortality, and harvesting.
features.waterQuality: Water quality monitoring with alerts when parameters exceed configured thresholds.
features.finance: Management of expenses, revenue, and production margins.
features.multiTenant: Multi-farm management with data isolation and user management.
